recipes.name: Raspberry Lemonade Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Add all ingredients to a high-speed blender and blend until smooth.
Taste test. The raspberries are tart and the lemon is sour. If you feel it's needed, add more syrup to cut through the tartness.
Divide into bowls and add desired toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based yogurt that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Best to enjoy this smoothie immediately.
